newsitem.title: ITALY: Technical problems block Milan stock market trade.
newsitem.headline: Technical problems block Milan stock market trade.

text.p: Tecnical problems halted screen-based cash trade on the Milan stock exchange about 30 minutes after the official start, the bourse computer centre said.
A spokesman for the CED centre said he did not know when the problems were likely to be resolved.
Earlier, Reuters advised that most of Monday's last and references prices displayed were suspect (see page ALERT ).
Further information will be given as soon as possible.
